teaser: Our agents' iOS builds waited three times longer than they ran, on five Macs. One Mac job per push, then one build an hour, fixed it.
core_idea: When agents write apps, the scarce resource is the shared build machine: measure the queue, do fewer and longer jobs, and batch the team's work.
